M-060.Name: perf-stage0-harness
M-060.Summary: Stage 0 large-document measurement harness: the bench driver with real open/typing/scroll phases plus the optional same-run observer-overhead control, the deterministic fixture corpus with ASCII generators and sha256 shape metadata, the renderer-CI WebKit perf suite, the unit microbenches for serializers/word-count/TOC/history-copy, and the owner-run real-app acceptance tooling. C-LARGE-DOC-WAVE-A (2026-11-02): extended as a dependency handoff from M-063 — the bench driver gains the tail-mount phase (PHASE_TAIL_MOUNT with sync-region, budgeted tti_ms and tail-done fields, reported separately and never summed into open/typing), the --progressive bench-level flag and the paired legacy/progressive baseline capture per fixture (two-path baseline with commit, fixture hash, engine and run conditions per path); still instrumentation and tests only, absorbing no product responsibility, and V-M-063 proves the Wave A budgets through these seams.

Contract.Purpose: Own the repeatable Stage 0 evidence surface: deterministic fixtures and their byte pins, real-input typing and scroll measurement, the three labelled evidence tiers, and the baseline artifacts that found the owner decision gate. Measurements are observations, never product budgets.
Contract.Inputs: Committed corpus fixtures and generators; window.__BENCH_OPTIONS__ from the driver; the built renderer on the preview server; the owner-run capture manifest for the native tier.
Contract.Outputs: [BENCH] PHASE_* console markers, the driver's JSON report and verdict, baseline/large-doc/baseline.json plus baseline.md, and verified acceptance captures that stay outside the repository.
Contract.Errors: A required phase that is missing, SKIPPED, non-numeric or untruthful fails the driver and the WebKit CI suite; a browser/Playwright label claiming native evidence, a fixture hash mismatch or a phantom commit fails the capture verifier.

M-061.Name: page-width
M-061.DisplayName: Per-document page width store, resolution pipeline and quick-settings panel
M-061.Summary:
C-STABILIZE-PRODUCT-REPAIRS: the panel entry uses the final Aa text glyph with local 28px button chrome; its titlebar stacks above table walls. Table no-scroll/Auto reset rules are owned by M-012, and the width pipeline remains unchanged. C-STABILIZE-TABLE-AUTO-PERSISTENCE keeps an explicit Auto reset distinct from an absent default override and removes stale widths during profile normalization.
C-PAGE-WIDTH-TABLES (2026-11-02): page width as a first-class, per-document property, owned by the renderer seam that M-011 hosts. util/pageWidthStore.js is the document-scoped store — one prefs key (pageWidths) keyed by pathname, entries carry {value, unit, themeOverride?}, sanitize keeps finite positive numbers and the ch/px/% units only, the store caps at 200 newest entries, the rename/move follows the file through the same store/editor.js flows tableLayoutStore uses, untitled and guide tabs never gain an entry, every mutation serializes through one queue and a failed read never becomes the base of a write. util/pageWidth.js is the resolution pipeline and canvas model — document > theme > global with the active source named, ch/px/% conversion with the 10% preset snap and the nearest-preset anchor mark, canvas = window − sidebar and rendered = min(setting, canvas − indent) with the 400px floor and centring, clamping never mutates the stored value, and a % value recomputes on sidebar show/hide/drag without a content re-render. components/titleBar/quickSettings/ is the titlebar panel boundary — the shell plus the Page / View / Tables tabs built only from the C-38 component set in the neutral settings palette, following the light/dark member via data-darkmode and never tinted by the editor theme, inner interactions keep it open while outside click or Escape closes it, the footer opens the real Settings window, and the R-4 per-document theme override pins the document against the global cycle with the active source named. The host seam in editor.vue plus store/editor.js applies the resolved value as one inline custom property on the editor root (theme CSS can never win the cascade), re-applies on sidebar and window changes and moves the stored entry on rename. The Tables tab writes the same preference objects the rest of the app reads — the table mode model itself stays owned by M-012 (fn-tableResize); this module owns only the panel boundary over it. M-011 owns the renderer shell whose editor.vue, store/editor.js and titleBar mount points host this module; M-012 owns the muya engine whose editor surface consumes the resolved width and whose tableFullWidthDefault option the Tables tab feeds (V-M-061).

Contract.Purpose: Make page width a first-class per-document property: a width pinned on one file follows that file and never leaks into untitled documents, resolution is document > theme > global with the active source named, clamping never mutates the setting, % follows the canvas live, and one governed panel surface edits the same preference objects the rest of the app reads — no second source of truth.
Contract.Inputs: The per-file store entries over the mt::prefs channel (numbers, the ch/px/% unit enum, an optional theme id — never document content, never paths beyond the pathname keys); window and sidebar geometry for the canvas model; the shipped theme CSS for the View-tab swatch tiles (parsed in-process, memoized per theme).
Contract.Outputs: The resolved width and its named source applied as one inline custom property on the editor root; the persisted per-document store under the pageWidths prefs key; the quick-settings panel with its three live tabs; the View > Page Width menu state.
Contract.Errors: A failed prefs read aborts the mutation without writing (the store never wipes from a failed read); entries whose file is confirmed missing are pruned on load while «cannot tell» keeps them; a failed host apply or menu-state resolution degrades to the global default and logs its content-free marker — no reachable state wedges the editor width or silently drops a stored document value.

Interface.fn-pageWidthStore: the per-document store flows — loadPageWidthFor (read, prune, cap, write-back), savePageWidth (write or delete one file's entry), movePageWidthEntry (the rename move); queued, untitled never gains an entry
Interface.fn-pageWidth: resolve the effective width (document > theme > global, source named), convert ch/px/% with the 10% snap and the nearest-preset anchor, compute canvas/rendered with the 400px floor; clamping never writes
Interface.fn-quickSettings: the titlebar panel shell with the Page / View / Tables tabs — inner interactions keep it open, outside click or Escape closes it, the footer opens Settings
Interface.fn-applyHostPageState: the editor.vue/store/editor.js host seam — one inline custom property on the editor root, canvas re-applies on sidebar show/hide/drag and window changes, rename moves the entry

Sources.Source: host seam: src/renderer/src/components/editorWithTabs/editor.vue applyHostPageState; src/renderer/src/store/editor.js rename/move flows

M-061.Observability: Content-free markers at the store/host seams: BLOCK_PAGE_WIDTH_READ_FAILED, BLOCK_PAGE_WIDTH_WRITE_FAILED, BLOCK_PAGE_WIDTH_PRUNED (files=N capped=X), BLOCK_PAGE_WIDTH_MOVED, BLOCK_PAGE_WIDTH_MOVE_FAILED, BLOCK_PAGE_WIDTH_APPLY_FAILED, BLOCK_PAGE_WIDTH_MENU_STATE_FAILED.
